sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Part 340010 mechanical seal – proposed 24-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to secure our full need with Ravensteiner and propose one package from 2027-01-01: EUR 29.89/unit (our current unit price), 23,400 pcs/year, 24 months, 56 days lead time, payment 30 days net, DAP. If this package is agreed, the full annual quantity is binding on us.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); this is not a claim about your actual cost or margin.

Would you please seek your boss's price approval for EUR 29.89 per unit under this 24-month package? You would remain our lead for the negotiation.

We value a healthy, long-term supply relationship and look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Part 340010 mechanical seal – proposed 24-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Pricing authority for this segment resides with me. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We note your proposal for 23,400 units over 24 months. In consideration of the increased volume and extended contract term, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit.

Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: 36-month full-volume commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming that pricing authority for this segment rests with you. We are glad to conclude this with you directly.

To support your capacity planning, we raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 30.90/unit and add a third committed year. The package is EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 36 months, 56 days lead time, payment 30 days net, DAP, from 2027-01-01. The full annual quantity is binding on us in each of the three years. If you approve this complete package, we would conclude on it.

Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package.

We look forward to a long-term, reliable partnership.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: 36-month full-volume commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal for a 36-month contract and have adjusted our price accordingly. We have reviewed the delivery record you cited; however, it does not warrant a commercial adjustment. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. For the 36-month package at 23,400 units per year, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit. The contract term is 36 months, and our Lieferzeit is 56 days. 

This Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.
